_comment: Systems whose multi-file RomM roms RomMBat syncs, and how they land. A system is added only by its own certification pass: step 2 of the platform-certification skill. See docs/PLAN.md, 'Multi-file and multi-disc games are in scope, unlocked per platform'.

psx.evidence: Findings 310 to 315: RetroBat's EmulationStation lists roms/psx/<fs_name>/<fs_name>.m3u as one game with no disc shown, and the three libretro cores, DuckStation and mednafen load both discs from the playlist. Both bizhawk cores are handed disc 1 by emulatorLauncher whatever the layout.
